Dans l’application, ouvrez « Réglages IA: In the app, open “AI settings” with the icon at the top right, or “Providers and local AI” in the assistant. Choose “Local AI” to run a model on this computer for free, or OpenAI, Gemini or Claude with your personal key. Confirm with “Save”.
Choisissez « IA locale », puis « Vérifie: Choose “Local AI”, then “Check this computer”. Review system memory, processor, graphics card and storage. These estimates concern this computer; a CPU configuration may be slow.
« Installer le moteur local » ouvre la p: “Install the local engine” opens Ollama’s official page. Install it yourself, open it, then return and click “Detect models”. There is no silent installation.
Si Ollama utilise un autre disque, cliqu: If Ollama uses another disk, click “Choose the models folder” and run the diagnostic again. This choice measures space; it does not move files or change Ollama’s configuration.
Comparez les modèles Qwen3-VL Instruct 2: Compare the suggested Qwen3-VL Instruct 2B, 4B and 8B models based on measured resources. Check the stated size before downloading. A larger model does not guarantee a better photographic result.
Après le téléchargement, sélectionnez le: After downloading, select the model, click “Test this model”, then “Save”. The test uses a synthetic image: it checks a structured response, not the quality of future edits.
Ouvrez une photo, choisissez « Proposer: Open a photo, choose “Suggest adjustments”, describe your intention and run “Analyze this photo”. Preview, then “Apply adjustments”. For a batch, select photos and enable analysis of the selection; adjustments are applied as processing progresses.
Le cadrage existant est conservé. Les re: Existing framing is preserved. Portrait retouching requires a detected face. Even valid JSON may suggest unsuitable corrections: compare, tone them down and undo if necessary.
ComfyUI est le module génératif local av: ComfyUI is the advanced local generative module for “Creative editing” and “Extend the photo”. Ollama suggests adjustments; it does not replace this module.
Dans « Retouche générative locale », uti: Under “Local generative editing”, use “Install ComfyUI”, start the service, then “Detect ComfyUI”. Select the three suggested compatible components: diffusion model, text encoder and VAE decoder. The current workflow uses distilled FLUX.2 klein 4B.
Ces modèles se téléchargent séparément s: Download these models separately according to their instructions and licences. No generative weights are installed automatically. “Configuration available” confirms the configuration, without certifying successful inference. The memory budget is estimated; a large image needs more resources.
Choisissez votre fournisseur et ouvrez «: Choose your provider and open “Get a key”. Create a dedicated key in the official console. For Gemini, use AI Studio and check project access. For Claude, use a key limited to the relevant workspace.
Collez la clé dans sa carte et cliquez s: Paste the key into its card and click “Save”. Choose models available to your account, then use the settings “Save” button. “Key saved” confirms storage, never the validity of an API call.
Lancez ensuite l’analyse dans l’assistan: Then start analysis in the assistant. OpenAI and Gemini can also generate a variant depending on the chosen model; Claude suggests adjustments. A cloud action sends a preview to the provider and may incur charges, including for each photo in a batch. Check its pricing and privacy terms. Local Ollama analysis uses no API key.
Service introuvable : ouvrez Ollama ou C: Service not found: open Ollama or ComfyUI, check the local address and run detection again. Model missing or without vision: choose a compatible installed model. Insufficient memory or disk: choose a lighter model or the correct storage volume.
La mémoire libre mesurée n’est pas toute: Measured free memory is not all the memory the system can reclaim. WebGL contexts for faces and WebGL 2 for spatial view are checked separately; their unavailability does not prevent standard adjustments or Ollama analysis.
Cette Bêta ne garantit ni la compatibili: This Beta does not guarantee compatibility with every computer or the fidelity of a generated image. Keep your originals, check exports and avoid running several demanding tasks at once.
